tagline.en: Evansville to Port Huron — the newest long Interstate
tagline.zh: 从埃文斯维尔到休伦港，最新的长距离州际公路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: US 41 and Veterans Memorial Parkway on the south side of Evansville, Indiana — a temporary end until the Ohio River bridge is built
start.zh: 印第安纳州埃文斯维尔南侧，与 US 41、退伍军人纪念大道相接；在俄亥俄河大桥建成前为临时终点

end.en: I-94 near Port Huron, Michigan, a short distance from the Blue Water Bridge to Ontario
end.zh: 密歇根州休伦港附近，与 I-94 相接，距通往安大略的蓝水大桥不远

en: I-69 is the newest of the long Interstates, and the only two-digit route still being extended. Its continuous section runs from Evansville on the Ohio River north through Indianapolis and Fort Wayne into Michigan, then across the bottom of the state through Lansing and Flint to Port Huron and the Canadian border.

The two halves feel different because they were built sixty years apart. The Indiana–Michigan portion north of Indianapolis is a conventional 1960s and 1970s rural Interstate. South of Indianapolis the road is a twenty-first-century project, and much of it is a rebuilt state highway: the last stretch upgraded the SR 37 expressway to Interstate standard through suburbs that had grown up along it.

South of Evansville the route stops. I-69 resumes in Kentucky and reappears in Tennessee, Mississippi and Texas as separate designations, but there is no crossing of the Ohio River yet. The FHWA route log lists those southern sections as disconnected mileage.
zh: I-69 是长距离州际公路中最新的一条，也是唯一仍在延伸的两位数编号路线。其连续路段自俄亥俄河畔的埃文斯维尔北上，经印第安纳波利斯与韦恩堡进入密歇根，再横穿该州南部，经兰辛与弗林特抵休伦港及加拿大边境。
两个半段的感觉截然不同，因为它们的建设相隔六十年。印第安纳波利斯以北的印第安纳—密歇根路段，是典型的 1960、1970 年代乡村州际公路。印第安纳波利斯以南则是二十一世纪的工程，且大部分是改建的州级公路：最后一段把 SR 37 快速路提升至州际公路标准，而沿线的郊区早已依路而生。
埃文斯维尔以南，这条路就断了。I-69 在肯塔基重新出现，并在田纳西、密西西比和得克萨斯以彼此独立的编号露面，但目前尚无跨越俄亥俄河的路段。FHWA 路线登记表把这些南方路段列为互不相连的里程。

en: I-69 was not on the original mid-1950s Interstate planning maps. It was added in 1958 along a shorter route than the modern highway, and Michigan built freeway segments for it through the 1960s before receiving extra Interstate mileage in 1968 to push it north and east to Flint. Further extensions in 1973 and 1987 produced the route as it now runs.

Indiana finished first: its original 157 miles, from the north side of Indianapolis past Fort Wayne to the Michigan line, were complete by November 1971. Michigan took until October 1992, when a segment southwest of Lansing opened and finished not only I-69 in the state but Michigan's entire share of the Interstate System.

The same month, representatives of seven states met in Memphis and formed the Interstate 69 Mid-Continent Highway Coalition to promote extending the road to the Mexican border — the campaign that eventually produced the Evansville–Indianapolis extension and the southern fragments.
zh: I-69 并未出现在 1950 年代中期最初的州际公路规划图上。它于 1958 年被补入，且线路比今日更短；密歇根在 1960 年代陆续为它修建高速路段，1968 年获得追加的州际公路里程，才把它向北、向东推至弗林特。1973 与 1987 年的两次延伸，最终形成了今天的走向。
印第安纳先完工：自印第安纳波利斯北侧经韦恩堡至密歇根州界的原有 157 英里，于 1971 年 11 月建成。密歇根则一直等到 1992 年 10 月，兰辛西南一段通车，不仅使 I-69 在该州贯通，也使密歇根全部的州际公路配额告成。
同月，七个州的代表在孟菲斯集会，成立「69 号州际公路中大陆公路联盟」，推动把这条路延伸至墨西哥边境——正是这场运动，最终催生了埃文斯维尔至印第安纳波利斯的延伸段与南方的零散路段。

en: The Evansville–Indianapolis extension is one of the few modern American Interstate projects with a clean, publicly stated total, because it was managed as a single programme in six numbered sections over sixteen years. It is also one of the more instructive examples of how such a road gets paid for.

The final section, from Martinsville to I-465, cost about half of the entire programme on its own. Part of it was funded by an unrelated toll road two hundred miles away: in 2018 the Indiana Finance Authority amended its concession agreement with the operator of the Indiana Toll Road, raising fees for heavy vehicles, and directed a large share of the additional revenue to this section, which the state credits with completing it three years early.

The remaining gap is the Ohio River. Indiana and Kentucky signed a bi-state agreement in late 2025 to build the crossing jointly and own it equally, in keeping with the long practice for river bridges between the two states. Approach work on both banks is finishing; the bridge itself has not started.
zh: 埃文斯维尔至印第安纳波利斯的延伸段，是少数拥有清晰、公开总额的当代美国州际公路工程之一，因为它作为一个整体计划、分六个编号段、历时十六年推进。它也颇能说明这样一条路究竟是怎么付钱建起来的。
自马丁斯维尔至 I-465 的最后一段，单独就占了整个计划约一半的支出。其中一部分资金来自两百英里之外一条毫不相干的收费公路：2018 年，印第安纳金融管理局修订了与印第安纳收费公路运营方的特许协议，提高重型车辆收费标准，并把新增收入的大部分拨给这一段；州政府认为，正因如此该段才提前三年完工。
剩下的缺口是俄亥俄河。印第安纳与肯塔基于 2025 年年末签署双州协议，共同建设该跨河工程并各持一半所有权，延续两州之间河桥共有的长期惯例。两岸的接线工程即将完成，桥梁本体尚未开工。

value.en: 523.36 miles for the continuous Indiana–Michigan corridor — Indiana 320.82 and Michigan 202.54; the route log separately lists disconnected I-69 mileage in Kentucky (133.97), Tennessee (142.23), Mississippi (13.15) and Texas (82.82)
value.zh: 连续的印第安纳—密歇根走廊共 523.36 英里，其中印第安纳 320.82、密歇根 202.54；路线登记表另列互不相连的 I-69 里程：肯塔基 133.97、田纳西 142.23、密西西比 13.15、得克萨斯 82.82

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.zh: 埃文斯维尔至印第安纳波利斯延伸段

value.en: $4.3 billion for 142 miles over sixteen years, from the start of construction at Evansville in 2008 to completion in August 2024
value.zh: 142 英里、历时十六年，造价 43 亿美元；自 2008 年在埃文斯维尔开工至 2024 年 8 月完工

value.en: $2 billion to upgrade more than 26 miles of State Road 37 to Interstate standard, build ten new interchanges and more than 35 lane-miles of local access roads; begun 2019 and finished three years ahead of schedule
value.zh: 20 亿美元，将 26 英里以上的 SR 37 提升至州际公路标准，新建十座立交及 35 车道英里以上的地方接线道路；2019 年开工，比原计划提前三年完工

figures.source: Office of the Governor of Indiana and INDOT, August 2024

label.en: Toll road revenue directed to the final section
label.zh: 拨给最后一段的收费公路收入

value.en: $600 million from higher heavy-vehicle fees, after the Indiana Finance Authority amended its Indiana Toll Road concession agreement in 2018
value.zh: 6 亿美元，来自提高重型车辆收费后的收入；印第安纳金融管理局于 2018 年修订了印第安纳收费公路特许协议

label.zh: I-69 俄亥俄河跨越工程

value.en: A $1.4 billion joint Indiana–Kentucky project for 11.2 miles of new Interstate — 8.4 miles on new terrain and 2.8 miles of upgraded US 41 — plus a new bridge; construction of the bridge is expected to start in spring 2027 and to open in 2031
value.zh: 印第安纳与肯塔基合建的 14 亿美元项目，含 11.2 英里新建州际公路（8.4 英里为全新线位，2.8 英里为 US 41 改建）及一座新桥；桥梁预计 2027 年春开工、2031 年通车

figures.source: Indianapolis Business Journal, 6 August 2024; I-69 Ohio River Crossing NEPA reevaluation statement, August 2024; I-69 Ohio River Crossing project updates, 2026

label.en: Cost of the original Indiana and Michigan route
label.zh: 印第安纳与密歇根原有路段造价

why.en: No public figure exists for the 1960s and 1970s sections. Indiana and Michigan built them incrementally with federal aid accounted for by state and fiscal year, and Michigan's route was assembled from freeway segments originally built under other designations.
why.zh: 1960、1970 年代路段无公开数据。印第安纳与密歇根以渐进方式建设，联邦补助按州和财政年度核算；密歇根的路线则是由原本以其他编号建设的高速路段拼接而成。

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Indiana and Michigan collect counts per segment, and around Indianapolis I-69's designated path shares pavement with I-465, so traffic there cannot be attributed to I-69 alone.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。印第安纳与密歇根分段采集交通量；在印第安纳波利斯周边，I-69 的指定路径与 I-465 共用路面，该处车流无法单独归于 I-69。

timeline.en: I-69 is added to the Interstate System along a shorter route than the modern highway, having been left off the mid-1950s planning maps.
timeline.zh: I-69 被补入州际公路系统，线路比今日更短；它未出现在 1950 年代中期的规划图上。

timeline.en: The first freeway segment signed as I-69 in Michigan opens.
timeline.zh: 密歇根第一段挂牌为 I-69 的高速公路通车。

timeline.en: Michigan is granted additional Interstate mileage to extend I-69 north and east to Flint.
timeline.zh: 密歇根获得追加的州际公路里程，将 I-69 向北、向东延伸至弗林特。

timeline.en: Indiana completes its original 157 miles, from the north side of Indianapolis to the Michigan line, in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，印第安纳建成自印第安纳波利斯北侧至密歇根州界的原有 157 英里。

timeline.en: The last Michigan segment, southwest of Lansing, opens in October, completing Michigan's entire Interstate System. The same month, seven states meet in Memphis and form the Interstate 69 Mid-Continent Highway Coalition.
timeline.zh: 10 月，兰辛西南最后一段通车，密歇根全部州际公路配额告成。同月，七个州在孟菲斯集会，成立 69 号州际公路中大陆公路联盟。

timeline.en: Construction of the Evansville–Indianapolis extension begins in southwestern Indiana.
timeline.zh: 埃文斯维尔至印第安纳波利斯延伸段在印第安纳西南部开工。

timeline.en: The first three sections of the extension open to traffic in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，延伸段的前三段通车。

timeline.en: Section 5 is accepted into the Interstate inventory, and the Indiana Finance Authority amends the Indiana Toll Road concession to help fund the final section.
timeline.zh: 第 5 段被纳入州际公路清册；印第安纳金融管理局修订印第安纳收费公路特许协议，为最后一段筹资。

timeline.en: The Finish Line section and the I-69/I-465 interchange open in August, giving a continuous I-69 from Evansville to the Canadian border at Port Huron.
timeline.zh: 8 月，「终点线」路段与 I-69／I-465 立交通车，I-69 自埃文斯维尔至休伦港的加拿大边境连成一线。

timeline.en: Approach work for the Ohio River crossing at Evansville is reported 85 per cent complete in August and due to finish within the year; the new roads and bridges will not open to traffic until the river bridge does.
timeline.zh: 8 月，据报俄亥俄河跨越工程埃文斯维尔一侧的接线工程已完成 85%，预计年内完工；这些新建道路与桥梁要等跨河大桥通车后才会对外开放。
